synopsis: WorkSafe Western Australia's Significant Incident Report 226 describes an autonomous haul truck colliding with a manned water cart at night [f10660, f15684]. The turnaround loop was released in the control system, but its intersection was not delineated on the ground and the route was not communicated to other operators; WorkSafe identified inadequate change management as a contributory cause [f10661, f10662, f10664]. The truck detected the water cart, but its speed and response time were insufficient to prevent the collision, illustrating that detection and a correct digital route do not guarantee safe outcomes [f10663, f11258]. The research dates the incident to August 2015, although the report's page text does not state an incident date; the web page carries 11 March 2025, and the original report issue date remains uncertain [f10665, f11208, f10666, f11207].
